questions.explanation: Simple-matching distance = (number of mismatched attributes)/(total attributes) = 4/6 = 2/3.
questions.hint: Simple match distance = so thuoc tinh khac / tong so thuoc tinh. Dem so cot khac nhau roi chia.

questions.question: The MLE objective is to find parameters maximizing the likelihood of observed data drawn from a Gaussian. For D = {-4, 5, 14}, which parameter set (mu, sigma) produces the maximum L(N(mu, sigma^2) | D)?
questions.explanation: MLE mu = mean = 5 and MLE sigma = sqrt(162/3) approx 7.35. Among the choices with mu=5, sigma=9 gives a higher log-likelihood than sigma=4, so (mu=5, sigma=9) is best.
questions.hint: MLE Gaussian: mu = trung binh, sigma = do lech chuan mau. Chon dap an co mu dung va sigma gan nhat.

The contingency table is extremely skewed with a very large number of null transactions (papers by neither author). Which pattern-evaluation measure most properly reflects the collaboration proximity of {JL, HG}? Check all that apply.
questions.explanation: With many null transactions, Lift and chi-square are not null-invariant and become misleading. Kulczynski is a null-invariant measure and properly reflects the association.
questions.hint: Nhieu null transaction thi dung null-invariant metric (Kulczynski, cosine...). Lift va chi-square bi anh huong boi null.

questions.question: Consider support-based and null-invariant definitions for negative patterns, with epsilon = 0.01. In a database of 10^9 total transactions, 10^6 contain item A, 10^4 contain item B, and 10^2 contain both A and B. Which statement is true?
options: {A, B} is a negative pattern only by the null-invariant definition.
(P(B|A)+P(A|B))/2 = (10^-4 + 10^-2)/2 = 0.00505 < 0.01, so {A,B} is negative by the null-invariant definition (and this makes it negative overall).
{A, B} is not a negative pattern by either definition.
{A, B} is a negative pattern by both definitions.
{A, B} is a negative pattern only by the support-based definition.
questions.explanation: P(A,B)=10^-7 while P(A)P(B)=10^-8, so P(A,B) exceeds the independence value and it is NOT negative by the support-based definition. The null-invariant average (P(B|A)+P(A|B))/2 = 0.00505 < 0.01, so it is negative only by the null-invariant definition.
questions.hint: Support-based: P(A,B) << P(A)*P(B) => negative. Null-invariant: (P(A|B)+P(B|A))/2 < epsilon => negative. So sanh tung dinh nghia.

questions.question: Using the CloSpan algorithm with minimum support 15, mining derives sequences with projected-DB sizes: <c>:50, <ac>:40, <ab>:30, <bc>:50. After applying the backward sub-pattern and backward super-pattern pruning rules, which projected DBs remain? Select all that apply.
questions.explanation: <c> and its super-pattern <bc> share the same projected-DB size (50), so <c> is pruned; <ac>, <ab> and <bc> remain.
questions.hint: CloSpan: super-pattern cung kich thuoc projected DB => prune sub-pattern <c>.

questions.question: A data scientist applies the Lossy Counting algorithm to a transactional data stream. Bucket size w = 1000, stream length N = 10000, and the true count of item A is 100. Which of the following could be a possible output count for item A?
questions.explanation: The maximum undercount is N/w = 10, and overcounting is impossible, so the estimate must be in [90, 100]. Only 95 qualifies.
questions.hint: Nhớ error bound = N/w. Đáp án đúng luôn nằm giữa (true count - N/w) và true count.

questions.question: The Kohonen self-organizing map (SOM) refers to which of the following?
options: The process of finding the right formal representation of a body of knowledge in order to represent it in a knowledge-based system.
A method that automatically maps an external signal space into a system's internal representational space; useful for classification tasks.
A process where an individual learns to carry out a task, transitioning from being unable to a being able to perform it under the same circumstances.
questions.explanation: A Kohonen SOM is an unsupervised neural network that maps a high-dimensional external signal space onto a low-dimensional internal representation, useful for classification and visualization.
questions.hint: SOM (Kohonen) = mang neural anh xa khong gian tin hieu ngoai vao khong gian bieu dien noi bo, ho tro phan loai.

questions.question: Which statement best describes a brute-force (exhaustive) search?
options: A stage of the KDD process in which new data is added to the existing selection.
The process of finding a solution to a problem by enumerating all possible solutions in some predefined order and then testing them.
The distance between two points as calculated using the Pythagorean theorem.
questions.explanation: A brute-force (exhaustive) search enumerates all candidate solutions in a fixed order and tests each until a valid one is found.
questions.hint: Brute-force = liet ke va thu tat ca giai phap theo thu tu. (Option C mo ta Euclidean distance, khong phai brute-force.)

questions.question: Discriminating between spam and ham (legitimate) e-mails is a classification task. True or false?
questions.explanation: Assigning e-mails to predefined categories (spam vs ham) using labeled data is a supervised classification task.
questions.hint: Phan loai email spam/ham = gan nhan lop da biet => classification (supervised).

questions.question: Points (2,3), (4,5), and (6,7) belong to a cluster. What is the centroid x-coordinate?
questions.explanation: The centroid x-coordinate is the mean of the x values: (2+4+6)/3 = 4.
questions.hint: Centroid chỉ là trung bình cộng của từng tọa độ: cộng các x rồi chia cho số điểm.

questions.question: Which stage presents mining results using charts, dashboards, or reports?
questions.explanation: Knowledge (result) visualization is the stage where mining results are communicated through charts, dashboards, and reports.
questions.hint: Bước trình bày kết quả bằng charts/dashboards chính là Knowledge visualization; các lựa chọn kia thuộc lưu trữ hay bảo mật.

questions.question: If SSE decreases after centroid updates, what does it indicate?
questions.explanation: Lower SSE (sum of squared errors) means points are closer to their centroids, so the clustering is improving.
questions.hint: SSE nhỏ = điểm sát centroid hơn, nên SSE giảm nghĩa là clustering đang tốt lên (nhớ: error giảm là tốt).

questions.question: Of the listed benefits of a fisheye lens, which is the least relevant to data visualization?
options: It makes the data appear more interesting.
It supports focus on detail along with the context of that detail amid the rest of the dataset.
It allows zooming without obscuring the unzoomed data.
questions.explanation: A fisheye lens' real value is focus-plus-context and non-obscuring zoom; merely making data look interesting is not a substantive visualization benefit.
questions.hint: Giá trị thật của fisheye lens là focus + context và zoom không che dữ liệu; 'trông thú vị hơn' chỉ là bề nổi nên ít liên quan nhất.

questions.question: Which techniques help analyze correlations between multiple numerical variables? (Choose 2 answers)
questions.explanation: A scatter plot matrix and a correlation heatmap both reveal pairwise relationships among multiple numerical variables; histograms and line charts show single-variable distributions or trends.
questions.hint: Muốn xem correlation giữa nhiều biến thì dùng scatter plot matrix và correlation heatmap; histogram/line chart chỉ mô tả một biến.

questions.question: If support(A)=0.5, support(B)=0.4, and support(A,B)=0.2, what is confidence(A→B)?
questions.explanation: Confidence(A→B) = support(A,B)/support(A) = 0.2/0.5 = 0.4.
questions.hint: Confidence(A→B) = support(A,B)/support(A); mẫu số luôn là vế trái A.

questions.question: A dataset has 1000 records visualized in a pie chart with 200 belonging to category A. What percentage does category A represent?
questions.hint: Phần trăm trong pie chart = phần / tổng: 200/1000 = 20%.

questions.question: Which type of pattern represents sequential relationships between events?
questions.explanation: Sequential patterns capture ordered relationships between events over time.
questions.hint: Nghe 'sequential' (theo trình tự thời gian) thì chọn Sequential patterns; đây là dạng sequential pattern mining.

questions.question: Which characteristics describe effective clusters? (Choose 3 answers)
questions.explanation: Good clusters have high similarity within a cluster, low similarity between clusters, and clear boundaries; random assignment and high noise indicate poor clustering.
questions.hint: Cluster tốt: giống nhau bên trong (high intra), khác nhau giữa các nhóm (low inter), ranh giới rõ; random và noise là dấu hiệu xấu.

questions.question: A dataset initially has 10 features. After dimensionality reduction it has 4 features. How many features were eliminated?
questions.explanation: 10 - 4 = 6 features were eliminated.
questions.hint: Số feature bị loại = ban đầu - còn lại: 10 - 4 = 6.

questions.question: If support(A)=0.4, support(B)=0.5, and support(A,B)=0.2, what is lift(A→B)?
questions.explanation: Lift = support(A,B)/(support(A)*support(B)) = 0.2/(0.4*0.5) = 0.2/0.2 = 1.0, indicating independence.
questions.hint: Lift = support(A,B)/(support(A)×support(B)); bằng 1 nghĩa là A và B độc lập.

questions.question: From the following list of statements, identify the factually correct ones.
options: Dimensionality reduction helps make high-dimensional clustering more feasible and scalable.
There are no clustering algorithms that can handle time-series data since we always assume that the data points are temporally independent from each other.
Since cluster analysis is unsupervised learning, there's no way to incorporate user preference or guidance into the clustering process.
questions.explanation: Dimensionality reduction improves feasibility and scalability of clustering; B and C are false (time-series clustering exists and semi-supervised/constrained clustering can use guidance).
questions.hint: Câu chứa 'always/no way' thường sai; dimensionality reduction giúp clustering high-dimensional khả thi hơn nên đó là câu đúng.

questions.question: If support(A,B)=0.3 and support(A)=0.6, what is confidence(A→B)?
questions.explanation: Confidence(A→B) = support(A,B)/support(A) = 0.3/0.6 = 0.5.
questions.hint: Confidence = support(A,B)/support(A) = 0.3/0.6 = 0.5.

questions.question: Which pattern discovery method finds relationships among variables in large databases?
questions.explanation: Association rule mining discovers relationships/associations among variables (items) in large databases.
questions.hint: Tìm 'relationships among variables' thì nghĩ ngay Association rule mining (kiểu bia-tã lót).

questions.question: Which characteristics make a visualization effective for data mining analysis? (Choose 3 answers)
questions.explanation: Effective visualizations use clear labels, an appropriate chart type, and minimal data distortion; random colors reduce clarity.
questions.hint: Visualization tốt: nhãn rõ, chart type phù hợp, ít bóp méo dữ liệu; 'random color' là dấu hiệu loại.

questions.question: A cluster contains distances 1, 2, 3, 4 from centroid. What is the average distance?
questions.hint: Trung bình khoảng cách = tổng/số điểm = 10/4 = 2.5.

questions.question: In a dataset with 300 transactions, item A appears in 90 transactions. What is support(A)?
questions.hint: Support = số transaction chứa item / tổng transaction = 90/300 = 0.30.

questions.question: Which clustering algorithm requires the number of clusters to be specified beforehand?
questions.explanation: K-Means requires k (the number of clusters) as input; DBSCAN and OPTICS are density-based and do not, and agglomerative builds a hierarchy without a preset k.
questions.hint: Chữ 'K' trong K-Means chính là số cluster phải khai báo trước; DBSCAN/OPTICS thì không cần.

questions.question: A dataset with 600 samples is visualized using a pie chart. If category A contains 150 samples, what percentage does category A represent?
Which techniques are used for dimensionality reduction before visualization? (Choose 3 answers)
questions.explanation: PCA, t-SNE, and UMAP are dimensionality reduction techniques; linear regression is a predictive/regression method.
questions.hint: Bộ ba dimensionality reduction hay gặp: PCA, t-SNE, UMAP; linear regression là dự đoán, không giảm chiều.

questions.question: Which evaluation metric measures cluster compactness and separation?
questions.explanation: The silhouette coefficient measures how compact points are within a cluster versus how separated they are from other clusters; support, confidence, and lift are association-rule metrics.
questions.hint: Đánh giá cluster (compactness + separation) dùng Silhouette; support/confidence/lift là của association rules.

questions.question: A scatter plot shows points evenly spread with no visible trend. What can be inferred about correlation?
questions.explanation: No visible trend in a scatter plot indicates little or no linear relationship, so correlation is near zero.
questions.hint: Điểm rải đều không xu hướng = không có quan hệ tuyến tính, correlation gần 0.

questions.question: What type of interactive visualization would you embed in a webpage to allow viewers to explore your prepared data?
questions.explanation: An interactive visualization embedded in a webpage lets viewers explore the data directly (filtering, zooming, hovering).
questions.hint: Cho người xem tự khám phá (filter/zoom/hover) trên web = Interactive visualization.

questions.question: In 200 transactions, itemset {A,B} appears in 30 transactions. What is its support percentage?
Which technique discovers relationships among items frequently appearing together?
questions.explanation: Association rule mining (frequent pattern mining) finds items that frequently co-occur in transactions.
questions.hint: 'Items frequently together' = Association rule mining (frequent pattern).

questions.question: If 400 out of 1000 records are used for validation and testing, how many remain for training?
questions.explanation: 1000 total minus 400 used for validation/testing leaves 600 records for training.
questions.hint: Training = tổng - (validation + testing) = 1000 - 400 = 600.

questions.question: If lift(A→B)=1, what does this imply?
questions.explanation: A lift value of exactly 1 means A and B occur together no more or less than expected by chance, so they are statistically independent.
questions.hint: Lift = 1 → độc lập; >1 là hút nhau, <1 là đẩy nhau.

questions.question: Which of the following algorithms belongs to the partition-based clustering category?
questions.explanation: K-Means is the classic partition-based (partitioning) clustering algorithm; DBSCAN is density-based and GMM/Mixture Models are model-based.
questions.hint: Partition-based tiêu biểu là K-Means; DBSCAN là density-based, GMM là model-based.

questions.question: If 300 out of 500 records belong to class A, what percentage of the dataset is class A?
questions.hint: Tỉ lệ class = 300/500 = 60%.

questions.question: Which step in the data mining pipeline involves collecting raw data from multiple sources?
questions.explanation: Data acquisition (data collection) is the stage where raw data is gathered from multiple sources.
questions.hint: Thu thập raw data từ nhiều nguồn = Data acquisition (bước đầu tiên của pipeline).

questions.question: Which characteristics indicate good clustering results? (Choose 3 answers)
questions.explanation: Good clustering maximizes similarity within clusters (high intra-cluster similarity), keeps clusters distinct from each other (low inter-cluster similarity), and yields clear separation between clusters.
questions.hint: Nhớ công thức 'high intra, low inter, clear separation'; random và noise luôn là đáp án sai.

questions.question: Which type of attribute has only two possible values, such as true/false?
questions.explanation: A binary attribute has exactly two possible values (e.g., true/false, 0/1).
questions.hint: 'Bi' = hai; Binary attribute chỉ có hai giá trị (true/false, 0/1).

questions.question: In a dataset of 400 transactions, itemset {A,B} occurs in 80 transactions. What is support?
A scatter plot shows points forming an upward trend. What does this suggest?
questions.explanation: An upward trend (both variables increasing together) indicates a positive correlation.
questions.hint: Đường đi lên (cùng tăng) = positive correlation; đi xuống là negative.

questions.question: Which algorithms belong to density-based clustering? (Choose 3 answers)
questions.explanation: DBSCAN, OPTICS, and Mean Shift are density-based clustering algorithms; K-Means is partition-based and Decision Trees are a classification method.
questions.hint: Density-based: DBSCAN, OPTICS, Mean Shift; K-Means là partition, Decision Trees là classification.

questions.question: If a dataset contains 500 transactions and an itemset appears in 50 transactions, what is its support?
What is the main purpose of data visualization in data mining?
options: To present data patterns visually for easier interpretation
questions.explanation: Data visualization presents data and patterns graphically so they are easier to understand and interpret.
questions.hint: Mục đích visualization là trình bày pattern trực quan để dễ hiểu, không phải lưu trữ hay mã hóa.

questions.question: A dataset originally has 40 attributes. After preprocessing, 28 attributes remain. How many were removed?
questions.explanation: 40 - 28 = 12 attributes were removed.
questions.hint: Số attribute bị bỏ = 40 - 28 = 12.

questions.question: Which of the following algorithms is incompatible with approximate frequent pattern mining in streaming data?
questions.explanation: FP-growth is a batch, exact frequent-pattern algorithm requiring multiple passes over stored data; Space-saving, Sticky sampling, and Lossy counting are streaming approximate-counting algorithms.
questions.hint: FP-growth là batch/exact quét nhiều lần nên không hợp streaming; các thuật toán 'counting/sampling' còn lại mới dành cho stream.

questions.question: A correlation heatmap shows r = −0.85 between two variables. What does this imply?
questions.explanation: r = −0.85 is close to −1, indicating a strong negative (inverse) linear relationship.
questions.hint: r gần -1 (như -0.85) = quan hệ nghịch mạnh (strong negative).

questions.question: A dataset contains 2000 samples, and 10% contain missing values removed during cleaning. How many samples remain?
questions.explanation: 10% of 2000 = 200 removed, leaving 2000 - 200 = 1800 samples.

questions.question: Which chart is typically used to compare categories of data?
questions.explanation: A bar chart compares values across discrete categories; a histogram shows distribution of a continuous variable.
questions.hint: So sánh giữa các category rời rạc dùng Bar chart; histogram là cho phân phối biến liên tục.

questions.question: If a cluster contains 50 points out of 200 dataset points, what percentage does it represent?
Which visualization is useful for displaying the proportion of categories in a dataset?
questions.explanation: A pie chart shows the proportional share of each category relative to the whole.
questions.hint: Xem tỉ lệ phần trăm của các category dùng Pie chart (miếng bánh = phần trăm).

questions.question: Which tasks belong to pattern discovery in data mining? (Choose 3 answers)
questions.explanation: Frequent pattern mining, sequential pattern mining, and association rule mining are pattern-discovery tasks; file compression and encryption are not data mining tasks.
questions.hint: Pattern discovery gồm các task có chữ 'mining' (frequent/sequential/association); compression và encryption không phải.

questions.question: Which clustering algorithm can detect clusters of arbitrary shape and identify noise?
questions.explanation: DBSCAN, a density-based method, finds arbitrarily shaped clusters and labels low-density points as noise/outliers.
questions.hint: Cluster hình dạng bất kỳ + phát hiện noise = DBSCAN; K-Means chỉ ra cụm hình cầu và không nhận noise.

questions.question: Which technique helps reduce dimensionality for visualization purposes?
questions.explanation: Principal Component Analysis (PCA) reduces the number of dimensions while preserving variance, commonly used to visualize high-dimensional data.
questions.hint: Giảm chiều để trực quan hóa dùng PCA (giữ variance); SQL indexing/hashing không liên quan.

questions.question: Which clustering method merges clusters iteratively until one cluster remains?
questions.explanation: Agglomerative hierarchical clustering is bottom-up: it repeatedly merges the closest clusters until a single cluster remains.
questions.hint: 'Merge dần đến khi còn 1 cluster' = Agglomerative (bottom-up); nhớ agglomerate nghĩa là gom lại.

questions.question: If a dataset contains 100 attributes and dimensionality reduction removes 45 attributes, how many remain?
questions.explanation: 100 - 45 = 55 attributes remain.

questions.question: Which characteristics describe strong association rules? (Choose 3 answers)
questions.explanation: Strong association rules have high support (frequent), high confidence (reliable), and high lift (positive correlation beyond chance).
questions.hint: Rule mạnh cần bộ ba cao: support (thường xuyên), confidence (đáng tin), lift (hơn ngẫu nhiên).

questions.question: Which kind of visualization would you use to create a web page that allows viewers to see a visualization of data that you prepared, but also allows the viewer to further investigate the data?
questions.explanation: A prepared, curated narrative that the viewer can then explore further combines presentation with exploration, which is interactive storytelling.
questions.hint: Vừa kể chuyện đã chuẩn bị sẵn, vừa cho người xem tự đào sâu => Interactive storytelling.

questions.question: True or false: when visualizing data, you should keep your eyes focused on one point for the entire duration of the visualization.
options: True, because your visual system will better detect any changes to datapoints during the visualization.
False, because your visual system will play tricks on your perception of the data.
True, because holding a single fixation reduces eye strain during long visualizations.
questions.explanation: Fixating on a single point causes perceptual artifacts such as fading, afterimages and adaptation, so the eyes should be allowed to move around the display.
questions.hint: Nhìn chằm chằm một điểm thì visual system sẽ 'đánh lừa' bạn => False.

questions.question: Suppose we have a dataset representing an image consisting of pixel records of the form (x, y, b), where x and y are the spatial coordinates of the pixel and b is its brightness. Which of the following provides the best histogram of the data?
options: A subdivision of the image's brightness values into ranges, plotting the count of the pixels whose brightness is in each range
A subdivision of the image into spatial regions, plotting the average brightness of each region
A scatter plot of the x coordinate against the y coordinate of every pixel
A line plot of brightness b against the pixel index, one point per pixel
questions.explanation: A histogram bins one variable's values and plots the frequency of records in each bin, so binning brightness and counting pixels per bin is the histogram of this dataset.
questions.hint: Histogram = chia giá trị thành bins rồi đếm số bản ghi trong mỗi bin, ở đây bin theo brightness.
questions.review: Đề gốc thiếu lựa chọn/dữ liệu — phương án nhiễu do AI dựng, đáp án đúng lấy từ đáp án chính thức.

questions.question: Suppose we have a dataset representing an image consisting of pixel records of the form (x, y, b), where x and y are the spatial coordinates of the pixel and b is its brightness. Which of the following represents a "rollup" of the x and y dimensions?
options: The average brightness of the image
The brightness of the pixel at the center of the image
The list of all brightness values sorted by x and then by y
A histogram of the brightness values of the image
questions.explanation: Rolling up (aggregating away) both spatial dimensions collapses every pixel into a single aggregate value, i.e. the average brightness of the whole image.
questions.hint: Rollup = gộp bỏ dimension bằng aggregate; bỏ cả x lẫn y thì chỉ còn một số: average brightness.
questions.review: Đề gốc thiếu lựa chọn/dữ liệu — phương án nhiễu do AI dựng, đáp án đúng lấy từ đáp án chính thức.

questions.question: Suppose we have a dataset representing an image consisting of pixel records of the form (x, y, b), where x and y are the spatial coordinates of the pixel and b is the brightness. Which axis definition would we NOT use if we wanted to plot the pixel brightness at a unique axis location for every pixel in the image?
options: An axis formed by the product of the x dimension and the y dimension
An axis formed by the concatenation of the x dimension and the y dimension
An axis formed by nesting the x dimension under the y dimension
questions.explanation: Product and nesting both generate one slot per (x, y) combination, but concatenation just places the x values after the y values, so many pixels would collide at the same axis location.
questions.hint: Concatenation chỉ nối hai trục lại (x rồi y), không tạo đủ vị trí cho từng cặp (x,y); product và nesting mới tạo unique location.

questions.question: Given Table 1 with transactions T10 {Beer, Nuts, Diapers}, T20 {Beer, Coffee, Diapers, Nuts}, T30 {Beer, Diapers, Eggs}, T40 {Beer, Nuts, Eggs, Milk}, T50 {Nuts, Coffee, Diapers, Eggs, Milk}, and min-support s = 40%, which of the following is a length-3 frequent itemset?
questions.explanation: minsup 40% of 5 transactions = 2 transactions. {Beer, Nuts, Diapers} appears in T10 and T20 (count 2), while each of the other itemsets appears in at most one transaction.
questions.hint: Đổi minsup 40% x 5 = 2 giao dịch, rồi đếm; chỉ {Beer, Nuts, Diapers} đạt count 2 (T10, T20).

questions.question: Given Table 1 with transactions T10 {Beer, Nuts, Diapers}, T20 {Beer, Coffee, Diapers, Nuts}, T30 {Beer, Diapers, Eggs}, T40 {Beer, Nuts, Eggs, Milk}, T50 {Nuts, Coffee, Diapers, Eggs, Milk}, what are the confidence and relative support of the association rule {Diapers} => {Coffee, Nuts}?
questions.explanation: {Diapers, Coffee, Nuts} occurs in T20 and T50, so relative support = 2/5 = 0.4; Diapers occurs in 4 transactions, so confidence = 2/4 = 0.5.
questions.hint: Support tính trên TOÀN bộ DB (2/5), confidence chỉ chia cho vế trái (2/4).

questions.question: Given Table 1 with transactions T10 {Beer, Nuts, Diapers}, T20 {Beer, Coffee, Diapers, Nuts}, T30 {Beer, Diapers, Eggs}, T40 {Beer, Nuts, Eggs, Milk}, T50 {Nuts, Coffee, Diapers, Eggs, Milk}, with minsup = 50% and minconf = 50%, which of the following is NOT a strong association rule?
questions.explanation: A strong rule must satisfy both thresholds. support({Beer, Nuts, Diapers}) = 2/5 = 40% < 50%, so that rule fails the support test, while all the other rules have support 60% and confidence 75%.
questions.hint: Rule mạnh phải đạt CẢ support lẫn confidence; {Beer,Nuts,Diapers} chỉ 40% < 50% nên rớt ngay ở support.

questions.question: Given Table 1 with transactions T10 {Beer, Nuts, Diapers}, T20 {Beer, Coffee, Diapers, Nuts}, T30 {Beer, Diapers, Eggs}, T40 {Beer, Nuts, Eggs, Milk}, T50 {Nuts, Coffee, Diapers, Eggs, Milk}, with minsup = 50% and minconf = 50%, which of the following are association rules? (Select all that apply.)
questions.explanation: {Beer, Nuts} occurs in T10, T20, T40 (60% support, confidence 3/4 = 75%) and {Nuts, Diapers} occurs in T10, T20, T50 (60% support, confidence 3/4 = 75%); the remaining pairs have support below 50%.
questions.hint: minsup 50% của 5 giao dịch nghĩa là cần >= 3 lần xuất hiện; chỉ Beer-Nuts và Nuts-Diapers đạt 3.

questions.question: Given Table 1 with transactions T10 {Beer, Nuts, Diapers}, T20 {Beer, Coffee, Diapers, Nuts}, T30 {Beer, Diapers, Eggs}, T40 {Beer, Nuts, Eggs, Milk}, T50 {Nuts, Coffee, Diapers, Eggs, Milk}, with minsup = 50% and minconf = 50%, which of the following are association rules? (Select all that apply.)
questions.explanation: Only {Nuts, Diapers} (T10, T20, T50) and {Beer, Nuts} (T10, T20, T40) reach 60% support with 75% confidence; Coffee-Milk, Diapers-Eggs and Nuts-Eggs all fall below the 50% support threshold.
questions.hint: Cùng bộ dữ liệu như câu trước, chỉ đảo thứ tự đáp án: vẫn là Nuts=>Diapers và Beer=>Nuts.

questions.question: Given Table 1 with transactions T10 {Beer, Nuts, Diapers}, T20 {Beer, Coffee, Diapers, Nuts}, T30 {Beer, Diapers, Eggs}, T40 {Beer, Nuts, Eggs, Milk}, T50 {Nuts, Coffee, Diapers, Eggs, Milk}, with minsup = 50%, which of the following is NOT a frequent itemset?
questions.explanation: Coffee appears only in T20 and T50, i.e. 2/5 = 40% < 50%, whereas {Eggs} = 60%, {Beer, Diapers} = 60% and {Beer} = 80% all pass the threshold.
questions.hint: Đếm nhanh: Coffee chỉ 2/5 = 40% nên trượt minsup 50%.

questions.question: Given Table 1 with transactions T10 {Beer, Nuts, Diapers}, T20 {Beer, Coffee, Diapers, Nuts}, T30 {Beer, Diapers, Eggs}, T40 {Beer, Nuts, Eggs, Milk}, T50 {Nuts, Coffee, Diapers, Eggs, Milk}, a strong association rule satisfies both minsup and minconf. Given minsup s = 50% and minconf c = 50%, how many strong association rules are there (rules A => B and B => A are counted as distinct)?
questions.explanation: The frequent 2-itemsets at 50% support are {Beer, Nuts}, {Beer, Diapers} and {Nuts, Diapers} (each 60%), and each direction has confidence 3/4 = 75% >= 50%, giving 3 x 2 = 6 strong rules.
questions.hint: 3 cặp frequent 2-itemset x 2 chiều = 6 strong rules.

questions.question: Consider the database with transactions T1 {a1, a2, a3}, T2 {a2, a3, a4}, T3 {a1, a3, a4}. Let minsup = 2. Which of the following frequent patterns is NOT closed?
questions.explanation: {a1} has support 2 (T1, T3), and its proper superset {a1, a3} also has support 2, so {a1} is not closed.
questions.hint: {a1} luôn đi kèm a3 => {a1,a3} cùng support 2, nên {a1} không closed.

questions.question: Consider the database with transactions T1 {a1, a2, a3, a4, a5} and T2 {a2, a3, a4, a5, a6}. Let minsup = 1. Which of the following patterns is BOTH a max frequent pattern and a closed frequent pattern? (Select all that apply.)
questions.explanation: The two transactions themselves, {a1..a5} and {a2..a6}, each have support 1 and no frequent proper superset, so they are max frequent and therefore also closed; {a2,a3,a4,a5} and {a2,a5} have supersets of equal support, and {a1..a6} is not frequent at all.
questions.hint: Với minsup = 1, mỗi transaction chính là một max pattern; max luôn kéo theo closed.

questions.question: Consider the database with transactions T1 {a1, a2, a3} and T2 {a2, a3, a4}. With minsup = 1, what fraction of all frequent patterns is max frequent patterns?
questions.explanation: The frequent patterns are all non-empty subsets of T1 or T2: 7 + 7 - 3 shared subsets of {a2,a3} = 11 in total, and the max frequent patterns are just {a1,a2,a3} and {a2,a3,a4}, so the fraction is 2/11.
questions.hint: Đếm bằng inclusion-exclusion: 7 + 7 - 3 = 11 frequent patterns, max chỉ có 2 => 2/11.
questions.review: Đề gốc thiếu lựa chọn/dữ liệu — phương án nhiễu do AI dựng, đáp án đúng lấy từ đáp án chính thức.

questions.question: Given the set of closed frequent patterns, we can ______. (Select all that apply.)
options: Recover all frequent patterns and their support in some situations but not all
Find the set of max frequent patterns
Always recover all frequent patterns and their support
Recover all transactions in the database
questions.explanation: Closed frequent patterns are a lossless compression: their supports let us reconstruct every frequent pattern with its support and hence identify the max patterns. The official key also marks the last option as correct (with minsup = 1 the closed patterns do encode the distinct transactions), even though in general it only holds for a sufficiently low minsup.
questions.hint: Closed = nén không mất thông tin (lossless) => suy ra được mọi frequent pattern, support và cả max patterns.

questions.question: Which of the following statements about closed frequent patterns and max frequent patterns is true?
options: The set of closed frequent patterns is always the same as the set of max frequent patterns.
Closed frequent patterns can always be determined from the set of max frequent patterns.
Since both closed and max frequent patterns are a subset of all frequent patterns, we cannot recover all frequent patterns and their supports given just the closed and max frequent patterns.
We can recover all frequent patterns and their supports from the set of max frequent patterns.
We can recover all frequent patterns and their supports from the set of closed frequent patterns.
questions.explanation: Closed frequent patterns keep the support information, so they form a lossless compression from which every frequent pattern and its support can be derived; max frequent patterns keep only the pattern boundaries, losing support values.
questions.hint: Closed = lossless (giữ support), Max = lossy (chỉ giữ biên) => chỉ closed mới khôi phục được support.

questions.question: If we know the support of the itemset {a, b, c} is 10, which of the following numbers are possible supports of the itemset {a, b}? (Select all that apply.)
questions.explanation: By the Apriori/anti-monotone property a superset can never be more frequent than its subset, so support({a,b}) >= support({a,b,c}) = 10; 11 and 10 are possible but 9 is not.
questions.hint: Subset luôn có support >= superset (Apriori anti-monotone) => {a,b} phải >= 10.

questions.question: If we know the support of the itemset {a, b} is 10, which of the following numbers are possible supports of the itemset {a, c}? (Select all that apply.)
questions.explanation: {a, b} and {a, c} are not in a subset-superset relationship, so the support of one places no constraint on the other; 9, 10 and 11 are all possible.
questions.hint: Không phải quan hệ subset-superset thì không ràng buộc nhau => cả ba giá trị đều được.

questions.question: If the support of the itemset {a} is 50 and the support of the itemset {a, b, c} is 10, which of the following are possible supports of the itemset {a, w}? (Select all that apply.)
questions.explanation: {a, w} is a superset of {a}, so its support can be anything from 0 up to support({a}) = 50; 100 exceeds that bound and is impossible, while 5, 10, 30 and 50 are all allowed.
questions.hint: Trần của mọi superset chứa a chính là support({a}) = 50; giá trị 100 vượt trần nên loại.

questions.question: If we know the support of the itemset {a, b} is 10, which of the following numbers are possible supports of the itemset {a, b, c}? (Select all that apply.)
questions.explanation: {a, b, c} is a superset of {a, b}, so its support cannot exceed 10; 9 and 10 are possible while 11 violates the anti-monotone property.
questions.hint: Thêm item vào itemset thì support chỉ có thể giữ nguyên hoặc giảm => <= 10.

questions.question: If the support of the itemset {a} is 50 and the support of the itemset {a, b, c} is 30, which of the following are possible supports of the itemset {a, b}? (Select all that apply.)
questions.explanation: {a, b} sits between {a, b, c} and {a}, so 30 <= support({a,b}) <= 50; of the listed values only 30 and 50 fall in that interval.
questions.hint: Kẹp giữa: support({a,b,c}) <= support({a,b}) <= support({a}), tức 30 <= x <= 50.

questions.question: In the Apriori algorithm, suppose all size-2 frequent itemsets are {A,B}, {A,C}, {A,D}, {B,C}, {B,E}, {C,E}. Which size-3 itemsets should be considered as candidates? (Select all that apply.)
questions.explanation: A size-3 candidate survives pruning only if all of its size-2 subsets are frequent. {B,C,E} needs BC, BE, CE (all frequent) and {A,B,C} needs AB, AC, BC (all frequent), while {A,C,D} fails on CD and {A,B,D} fails on BD.
questions.hint: Apriori pruning: kiểm tra cả 3 subset size-2; thiếu một cái là loại candidate.

questions.question: In the Apriori algorithm there are 5 items in total (A to E). The first scan finds that the frequent items are A, B, C and E. How many size-2 itemsets should be considered in the second scan?
questions.explanation: Apriori only combines frequent items, so the candidates are the pairs from {A, B, C, E}: C(4,2) = 6.
questions.hint: Chỉ ghép các item đã frequent: C(4,2) = 6, không phải C(5,2) = 10.

questions.question: Given the contingency table for Data Mining (DM) and Machine Learning (ML) course enrollment: among 1000 ML students, 700 also take DM and 300 do not; among 2000 non-ML students, 500 take DM and 1500 do not (column totals 1200 DM / 1800 not-DM, grand total 3000). What is lift(DM, ML)?
questions.hint: Công thức nhanh: lift = n x a / (row_total x col_total) = 3000 x 700 / (1000 x 1200) = 7/4.

questions.question: Given the contingency table for Data Mining (DM) and Machine Learning (ML) course enrollment: among 1000 ML students, 700 also take DM and 300 do not; among 2000 non-ML students, 500 take DM and 1500 do not (column totals 1200 DM / 1800 not-DM, grand total 3000). What is the chi-square score?
questions.hint: Tính expected = (row x col)/n, mọi ô lệch đúng 300, rồi cộng 300^2 chia từng expected => 562.5.

questions.question: Which of the following measures is NOT null invariant?
questions.explanation: Lift is computed from probabilities over the whole database, so the number of null transactions (neither A nor B) changes it; all-confidence, cosine and Kulczynski do not use that count.
questions.hint: Lift dùng tổng số giao dịch n nên bị ảnh hưởng bởi null transactions => không null-invariant.

questions.question: Which of the following measures is NOT null invariant?
questions.explanation: Chi-square, like lift, is computed from the full contingency table including the null cell, so it changes when null transactions are added; the other three are null-invariant.
questions.hint: Chi-square và lift đều 'nhìn' ô null (¬A¬B) nên không null-invariant.

questions.question: Three supermarkets S1, S2 and S3 have very different numbers of null transactions (customers buying neither apples nor bananas). Which measure(s) would you use to determine the correlation of apple and banana purchases consistently across all three supermarkets? (Select all that apply.)
questions.explanation: When the number of null transactions differs wildly you need a null-invariant measure; Kulczynski and cosine ignore the null cell, whereas chi-square and lift would give incomparable values.
questions.hint: Nhiều null transactions khác nhau => chỉ dùng null-invariant measures như Kulczynski và Cosine.

questions.question: Given the contingency table for Coffee Machine (CM) and Free Coffee (FC): among 1000 FC observations, 300 fall in the first column and 700 in the second; among 2000 non-FC observations, 1200 fall in the first column and 800 in the second (column totals 1500 / 1500, grand total 3000). What is the chi-square score?
questions.explanation: Expected counts are 500, 500, 1000 and 1000, and every observed cell deviates by 200, so chi-square = 200^2 x (1/500 + 1/500 + 1/1000 + 1/1000) = 40000 x 0.006 = 240.
questions.review: Đề gốc thiếu lựa chọn/dữ liệu — phương án nhiễu do AI dựng, đáp án đúng lấy từ đáp án chính thức.

questions.question: Two supermarkets have the following counts for buying A and B: S1 = (A&B = 100000, A&notB = 7000, notA&B = 3000, notA&notB = 300) and S2 = (A&B = 100000, A&notB = 7000, notA&B = 3000, notA&notB = 90000). Only the number of null transactions differs. Which statement about their chi-square and cosine values is correct?
questions.explanation: Chi-square is not null-invariant, so changing the null cell from 300 to 90000 changes it dramatically (about 34 vs about 162000), while cosine only uses the counts of A, B and A&B, so c1 = c2.
questions.hint: Đổi số null transactions: chi-square nhảy loạn, cosine đứng yên vì null-invariant.
questions.review: Đề gốc thiếu lựa chọn/dữ liệu — phương án nhiễu do AI dựng, đáp án đúng lấy từ đáp án chính thức.

questions.question: Given the contingency table for Hot Dog (HD) and Hamburger (HM): among 64 HM observations, 40 also involve HD and 24 do not; among 336 non-HM observations, 210 involve HD and 126 do not (column totals 250 HD / 150 not-HD, grand total 400). What is lift(HD, HM)?
questions.explanation: lift = (40/400) / ((250/400)(64/400)) = 0.1 / (0.625 x 0.16) = 0.1 / 0.1 = 1, meaning HD and HM are statistically independent.
questions.hint: lift = 1 nghĩa là hai biến độc lập; thấy 400 x 40 = 250 x 64 là biết ngay bằng 1.
questions.review: Đề gốc thiếu lựa chọn/dữ liệu — phương án nhiễu do AI dựng, đáp án đúng lấy từ đáp án chính thức.

questions.question: Given the contingency table for Hot Dog (HD) and Hamburger (HM): among 64 HM observations, 40 also involve HD and 24 do not; among 336 non-HM observations, 210 involve HD and 126 do not (column totals 250 HD / 150 not-HD, grand total 400). What is the chi-square score?
questions.explanation: Every expected count equals its observed count (e.g. 250 x 64 / 400 = 40), so all deviations are zero and chi-square = 0, confirming independence.
questions.hint: Observed = expected ở mọi ô => chi-square = 0, khớp với lift = 1 (độc lập).

questions.question: Suppose one needs to mine frequent patterns at two levels of abstraction, using minsup 5% at the higher level and 3% at the lower level. Using shared (uniform) multi-level mining, which minsup should be used to generate the candidate patterns for the LOWER level?
questions.explanation: Shared multi-level mining generates candidates once using the lowest minsup among the levels so that no lower-level pattern is missed, i.e. 3%.
questions.hint: Shared multi-level mining luôn dùng minsup NHỎ NHẤT (3%) để không bỏ sót pattern ở level dưới.
questions.review: Đề gốc thiếu lựa chọn/dữ liệu — phương án nhiễu do AI dựng, đáp án đúng lấy từ đáp án chính thức.

questions.question: Suppose you need to mine frequent patterns at two levels of a concept hierarchy, using min-support 5% at the higher (more general) level and 1% at the lower (more specific) level. Under shared multi-level mining, which min-support threshold should be used to generate the candidate patterns at the HIGHER level?
options: 5%, the threshold defined for the higher level
1%, the lowest threshold among all levels
3%, the average of the two thresholds
6%, the sum of the two thresholds
questions.explanation: In shared multi-level mining a single uniform threshold equal to the lowest min-support of all levels (here 1%) is used when generating candidates, otherwise items that are frequent only at the lower level would be pruned too early and their descendants lost.
questions.hint: Shared multi-level mining thì luôn dùng min-support NHỎ NHẤT (lowest) cho mọi level, nếu cắt theo 5% ở level trên là mất pattern ở level dưới.
questions.review: Đề gốc thiếu lựa chọn/dữ liệu — phương án nhiễu do AI dựng, đáp án đúng lấy từ đáp án chính thức.

questions.question: Consider the support-based and the null-invariant definitions of negative patterns with epsilon = 0.01. In a database of 10^9 total transactions, 10^6 contain A, 10^4 contain B, and 10^2 contain both. Which statement is true?
options: {A, B} is a negative pattern only by the null-invariant definition.
{A, B} is a negative pattern only by the support-based definition.
{A, B} is a negative pattern by both definitions.
{A, B} is not a negative pattern by either definition.
questions.explanation: s(A,B) = 10^-7 is greater than s(A)s(B) = 10^-8, so it is not negative by the support-based definition. Kulczynski = 0.5*(100/10^6 + 100/10^4) = 0.00505 < 0.01, so it is negative only by the null-invariant definition.
questions.hint: So sánh hai điều kiện riêng: support-based xem s(A,B) vs s(A)s(B); null-invariant xem Kulczynski vs epsilon.

questions.question: Transactions: T1 abcde, T2 abefg, T3 abcdef, T4 abcdf, T5 abcdeg. Using the pattern distance measure (1 minus the Jaccard similarity of the two transaction sets), what is the distance between pattern "abc" and pattern "abd"?
questions.explanation: "abc" occurs in {T1, T3, T4, T5} and "abd" also occurs in {T1, T3, T4, T5}, so the Jaccard similarity is 4/4 = 1 and the distance is 1 - 1 = 0.
questions.hint: Pattern distance = 1 - |giao|/|hợp| của tập transaction chứa pattern; hai pattern xuất hiện đúng cùng một tập thì distance = 0.

questions.question: Transactions: T1 abcde, T2 abefg, T3 abcdef, T4 abcdf, T5 abcdeg. Using the pattern distance measure (1 minus the Jaccard similarity of the two transaction sets), what is the distance between pattern "abcd" and pattern "acde"?
questions.explanation: "abcd" occurs in {T1, T3, T4, T5} and "acde" occurs in {T1, T3, T5}; the intersection has 3 transactions and the union has 4, so the distance is 1 - 3/4 = 0.25.
questions.hint: Liệt kê tập transaction của từng pattern rồi lấy 1 - |giao|/|hợp|, đừng nhầm sang đếm số item khác nhau.

questions.question: Transactions: T1 abcde, T2 abde, T3 abcdef, T4 abcdf. Using the pattern distance measure (1 minus |intersection| / |union| of the transaction sets), what is the distance between pattern "abcd" and pattern "abde"?
questions.explanation: "abcd" occurs in {T1, T3, T4} and "abde" occurs in {T1, T2, T3}; the intersection is {T1, T3} (2 transactions) and the union is {T1, T2, T3, T4} (4 transactions), so the distance is 1 - 2/4 = 0.5.
questions.hint: Nhớ mẫu số là HỢP của hai tập transaction (ở đây 4), không phải tổng số transaction trong DB.
questions.review: Đề gốc thiếu lựa chọn/dữ liệu — phương án nhiễu do AI dựng, đáp án đúng lấy từ đáp án chính thức.

questions.question: Given the sequence database (1: <a(bc)(de)cf>, 2: <a(bd)(bc)cf>, 3: <bc(ad)ebfcd>, 4: <(ab)(cd)d(ab)e>) with support threshold minsup = 3, which of the following sequences is frequent?
questions.explanation: <abc> (an a, then a b, then a c, in separate elements) is a subsequence of sequences 1, 2 and 4, so its support is at least 3 and it meets minsup = 3.
questions.hint: Với sequence không có ngoặc, chỉ cần tìm được a rồi b rồi c theo thứ tự ở các element khác nhau là đủ.

questions.question: Given the sequence database (1: <a(bd)(aef)(bc)>, 2: <(cf)(abe)(bd)d>, 3: <(def)(abcde)(cde)>, 4: <a(abe)cd(ec)>) with support threshold minsup = 3, which of the following sequences is frequent?
questions.explanation: <(ae)c> requires an element containing both a and e followed later by a c; this holds in sequences 1 ((aef) then (bc)), 3 ((abcde) then (cde)) and 4 ((abe) then c), giving support 3 >= minsup.
questions.hint: Gặp dạng <(xy)z> thì tìm element chứa ĐỦ x và y trước, rồi mới tìm z ở element sau.

questions.question: In the GSP algorithm, suppose the only frequent length-1 sequences (frequent singletons) found in the first pass are a, b and d. Which of the following could be candidate length-2 sequences generated for the next pass? (choose all that apply)
questions.explanation: GSP builds length-2 candidates only from frequent singletons, so every item in a candidate must be one of a, b, d. <ab> (two elements) and <(bd)> (one element with two items) qualify, while <ac> and <(bc)> contain the infrequent item c.
questions.hint: Candidate chỉ được ghép từ các item đã frequent ở pass trước; thấy item lạ (c) là loại ngay.

questions.question: In the GSP algorithm, suppose the only frequent length-1 sequences (frequent singletons) found in the first pass are a, b and d. Which of the following could be candidate length-2 sequences generated for the next pass? (choose all that apply)
questions.explanation: Candidates may only combine the frequent items a, b and d, so <ad>, <(bd)> and <ab> are all legal length-2 candidates; <bc> is rejected because c is not a frequent singleton.
questions.hint: Length-2 candidate của GSP gồm cả dạng <xy> (hai element) lẫn <(xy)> (một element), miễn là x, y đều frequent.

questions.question: In CloSpan with minsup = 15, the following projected databases and their sizes have been produced: <c> : 50, <ac> : 40, <ab> : 30, <bc> : 50. Which projected databases remain after backward sub-pattern / super-pattern pruning? (choose all that apply)
questions.explanation: CloSpan absorbs a projected database when a super-pattern has a projected database of identical size. Here |DB_<c>| = 50 = |DB_<bc>| and <c> is a sub-pattern of <bc>, so <c> is pruned; <ac>, <ab> and <bc> all remain (each is above minsup = 15).
questions.hint: CloSpan: nếu super-pattern có projected DB size BẰNG sub-pattern thì bỏ sub-pattern (equivalence pruning).

questions.question: In CloSpan with minsup = 15, the following projected databases and their sizes have been produced: <c> : 50, <ac> : 50, <ab> : 30, <bc> : 30. Which projected databases remain after backward sub-pattern / super-pattern pruning? (choose all that apply)
questions.explanation: |DB_<c>| = 50 equals |DB_<ac>| = 50 and <c> is a sub-pattern of <ac>, so the <c>-projected database is absorbed and pruned; <ab>, <bc> and <ac> remain since all exceed minsup = 15 and none is size-equivalent to a super-pattern.
questions.hint: Chỉ prune khi size projected DB TRÙNG NHAU giữa sub-pattern và super-pattern; khác size (30 vs 50) thì giữ cả hai.
